Prompt guidelines

              
            

            

              
The three sections

              
    
                
  • Personality — who the bot is. Name, tone, how it speaks.
    • 
                
  • Intent — what the bot is trying to do. The goal of every conversation.
    • 
                
  • Additional Information — special rules, edge cases, what to never do.
    • 
              

              
Tips that work

              
    
                
  • Write Personality in 1–2 sentences. More than that gets ignored.
    • 
                
  • Intent should be specific: "capture the visitor's email" beats "be helpful".
    • 
                
  • Put NEVER rules in Additional Information. The bot is much better at avoiding things you say "never" to.
    • 
                
  • If you find a bad answer in testing, add the rule that would prevent it.
    • 
              

              
Custom values

              
    
                
  • Click + Add Custom Value to insert merge tags like {{business.name}}.
    • 
                
  • The bot replaces them with real values from the current visitor's session.
    • 
              

              
Knowledge vs. prompt

              
    
                
  • Facts about your business (hours, services, prices) go in Knowledge, not the prompt.
    • 
                
  • The prompt is about behavior. Knowledge is about facts.
    •

Bold = direct, opinionated, will push back. Formal = measured, professional.
